about: Local employers and crew resources condensed from config/local-employers.json. Research contacts and hiring methods need confirmation; inclusion does not mean an opening is available. Scores: crew fit +3, Grand Strand +2 or Charleston +1, direct local hiring or careers route +1, phone +1; ties favor identified local towns, then research order.
